title: Herb Infused Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: A traditional Syrian dish featuring lamb infused with herbs and spices, served with a side of tangy mustard sauce. This recipe is inspired by Ayurvedic and tamasic principles.
instructions: Preheat the tandoor or oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each cube.
Place the skewers in the preheated tandoor or oven and cook for 15 minutes, turning occasionally.
While the lamb is cooking, mix the chopped chive with a tablespoon of mustard to make a tangy sauce.
Serve the lamb kebabs hot with the chive mustard sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with additional chopped chive and serve immediately.
